children: Fineos keeps its bull at Macquarie despite the enterprise software provider's failure to finalize new client sales in the September quarter. A note from one of the investment bank's analysts points out that the Australia-listed developer still has a strong pipeline, as well as the continued opportunity to cross- and up-sell products to existing customers. With free cash flow improving and annual revenue guidance reaffirmed, Macquarie keeps an outperform rating on the stock. Its target price is unchanged at 3.50 Australian dollars. Shares are up 2.1% at A$1.94. (stuart.condie@wsj.com)
